sources.title: Entry into Niger
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation, African Integration and Nigeriens Abroad
sources.officialityEvidence: Niger's Foreign Ministry publishes the current entry conditions and separates normal mission issuance from exceptionally authorized point-of-entry issuance according to the applicant's residence-country mission availability.
sources.supportingExcerpt: En principe la demande de visa se fait à partir du lieu de résidence du demandeur, auprès de la représentation diplomatique ou consulaire.

conditional.title: Niger visa issuance depends on residence-country mission availability
conditional.summary: Visa-liable visitors normally obtain a Nigerien visa through the mission serving their residence, but may exceptionally receive an authorized visa at the entry point when departing from a country without a Nigerien mission.
conditions: The normal route is application through the Nigerien diplomatic or consular mission serving the applicant's place of residence.
When the traveller departs from a country without a Nigerien mission, point-of-entry issuance is exceptional and requires prior authorization from the Interior Minister.
Bilateral and community exemptions remain separate exact policies and are excluded from this visa-liable cohort.
The issuance route depends on residence, mission availability and prior approval rather than passport nationality alone, so it does not change ranking status.
